description: Household interest burden (Norges Bank definition): household interest expenses as % of disposable income excl. dividends plus interest expenses, 4-quarter rolling sums of unadjusted quarterly sector-account flows
source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank, PxWebApi v0 csv2 (quarterly income and capital accounts by sector)
table_or_code: 11020:Sektor=h140000;Transaksjoner=U3222_ (Renteutgifter) and I3491UAB_H (Disponibel inntekt eksklusiv aksjeutbytte);ContentsCode=LPriser; derived 100*sum4(U3222_)/sum4(I3491UAB_H+U3222_)
unit: percent of disposable income excl. dividends + interest expenses
notes: SNA interest (D.41 paid by households, FISIM-adjusted) from the household sector (S.14, excl. NPISH). Latest vintage (table updated 2026-09-08; 2026K2 published 2026-09-08, 70 days). Value for quarter q uses flows q-3..q. Level and profile match Norges Bank's published burden (peaks ~12.5% 2008Q4 and ~11.7% 2024Q4, trough ~5.5% 2021). Sector-account income is revised; dividend-tax-driven swings avoided by using income excl. dividends.

description: Average interest rate on outstanding loans to households (incl. NPISH) from banks and mortgage companies, all loan types, end of quarter, total count
source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank, PxWebApi v0 csv2 (Renter i banker og kredittforetak, totaltelling)
notes: Weighted average of rates in force at quarter end on the outstanding stock (so it captures the pass-through of policy-rate changes to existing, mostly floating-rate mortgages). Release lag: ~6 weeks since 2015 (2026K2 published 2026-08-07, 38 days; SSB states 6 weeks) but 52-61 days in 2011-2014 (e.g. 2014K1 on 2014-05-26, 2014K2 on 2014-08-27, 2012K1 on 2012-05-31); 60 used conservatively, so the harness always uses quarter t-1 at the t+45 origin. Sector grouping changed 2012Q1 (SSB warns of a possible break; no visible jump: 2011Q4 4.59, 2012Q1 4.55). Household rows are missing before 2002Q1.

description: Europris total-return share price relative to the Oslo Bors Benchmark Index (OSEBX, gross/total-return index): monthly mean of daily ratio TR(EPR)/OSEBX, rebased 2015-06-19=100
source: Yahoo Finance chart API (daily close and dividend events); stooq was blocked (JS proof-of-work page / connection resets)
table_or_code: EPR.OL close + dividends (own total-return index, dividend reinvested at ex-date close) / OSEBX.OL close ('Oslo Bors Benchmark Index_GI')
notes: Market data, known in real time. 2015-06 is a partial month (IPO 2015-06-19, 8 trading days); 2026-10 partial month dropped. Own TR index agrees with Yahoo dividend-adjusted close within 1.5% over 11 years. Europris held a minority (associate) stake in Swedish ÖoB before consolidating it from May 2024, so the share price partly prices ÖoB throughout and fully from 2024; it is not a pure-Norway signal. Stock moves also reflect valuation multiples, not only earnings expectations. Downloaded 2026-10-12 (data to 2026-10-09).
